name: Storm — Strong Gusts, Turbulence, Bounded Canyon
description: Storm conditions: high-velocity gusts with turbulent fluctuations, bounding walls (canyon or building geometry), reduced visibility. Tests flock resilience.
notes: Box boundary models a canyon, urban canyon, or enclosed space. Boids bounce off walls (soft repulsion). High turbulence tests the flock's ability to maintain coherence under extreme perturbation — measuring the critical transition between ordered and disordered phases.
